title: The Ruby Glass Panel
scene: At 2:10 PM, the ruby glass panel vanished from the workbench. Only the master saw the tiny brass key left on the lead tray.

suspects.name: Wanda Keller
suspects.testimony: I admired the window displays from 1:50 to 2:15 PM—I never left any tiny brass key behind!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned a tiny brass key, and red glass dust smudged Wanda's velvet glove.

suspects.name: Ines Delgado
suspects.testimony: I sketched patterns in the front office from 1:50 to 2:10 PM before returning to the workbench.
suspects.alibiProof: A delivery courier waited with Ines in the front office from 1:55 to 2:10 PM.

suspects.name: Cedric Lloyd
suspects.testimony: I swept glass scraps right beside the workbench from 1:55 to 2:15 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: The studio window faces the street, where a neighbor watched Cedric sweeping from 1:55 to 2:15 PM.

suspects.name: Oscar Kim
suspects.testimony: I sanded oak frames in the courtyard from 1:50 to 2:15 PM and never entered the studio.
suspects.alibiProof: Two café guests on the adjoining patio heard Oscar sanding frames from 1:50 to 2:15 PM.
